Select molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL5360622. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Do not deduplicate; preserve all rows from compound_records. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
